answer: To spin up a sock-puppet farm, an attacker must fund and stake every fake identity, so cost scales linearly with influence, unlike free account creation. Require each agent to stake a bond locked to a hardware anchor key, and only count votes weighted by bonded stake. Unbonding is slow, letting peers slash proven cheaters. This layered defense is solid as shale and steady as a dune-anchored post in wind, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From qwe0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
